token.name: Goblin
token.text: No Store value. Vanishes when Removed.

cards.name: The Goblin King
cards.text: Whenever a goblin token you control is Removed, gain 1 Honor. Once per turn: sacrifice a token Companion you control → deal 1 damage to any Icon or Companion.
cards.flavor: The army is the weapon. The king only points.

cards.name: Rabble Horn
cards.text: When this enters the Field, make two Goblin tokens (1/0/1).
cards.flavor: One blast. A dozen footsteps.

cards.name: Scrap Runner
cards.text: When this Presses, you may sacrifice a token Companion you control. If you do, this gets +2 Strike this Press.
cards.flavor: He throws the little one first.

cards.name: Cave Sneak
cards.text: When this enters, make a Goblin token.
cards.flavor: They never count the last one.

cards.name: Warrens Boss
cards.text: At the start of your Clash, if you control 3 or more tokens, make a Goblin token.
cards.flavor: More hands. More knives.

cards.name: Mushroom Midwife
cards.text: When you make one or more tokens, heal 1 Health on your Icon.
cards.flavor: Birth and bandage in the same breath.

cards.name: Riot Drummer
cards.text: Once per turn: when you sacrifice a token, make a Goblin token unless an opponent pays 1 Will.
cards.flavor: The beat does not ask permission.

cards.name: Shield Gutter
cards.text: When this is Pressed, you may sacrifice a token Companion you control. If you do, prevent 2 of that damage.
cards.flavor: Someone has to stand in front.

cards.name: Breeding Pit Captain
cards.text: When a token you control is sacrificed, you may pay 1 Will. If you do, make a Goblin token.
cards.flavor: Loss is just another order.

cards.name: Knife Choir
cards.text: This has +1 Strike for each token Companion you control (max +3).
cards.flavor: They sing on the way in.

cards.name: Horde Caller
cards.text: When this enters, make two Goblin tokens. Then you may sacrifice a token: draw a card.
cards.flavor: Call. Cut. Count again.

cards.name: Soot Chaplain
cards.text: Sacrifice a token Companion you control: heal 2 Health on your Icon. Once per turn.
cards.flavor: The king's blood is more expensive than theirs.

cards.name: Pit Recruiter
cards.text: When this is Removed, make three Goblin tokens.
cards.flavor: Even dying, he hires.

cards.name: War-Boar Rider
cards.text: When this Presses an Icon, you may sacrifice any number of tokens. This deals +1 damage per token sacrificed.
cards.flavor: The boar does not stop for bodies.

cards.name: Matron of the Pits
cards.text: At the end of your turn, make a Goblin token for each token you sacrificed this turn (max 3).
cards.flavor: She keeps the ledger of the dead.

cards.name: Bone Sling
cards.text: Sacrifice a token Companion you control: deal damage equal to its Strike to target Icon or Companion.
cards.flavor: Aim with someone else's life.

cards.name: War Tithe Banner
cards.text: Once per turn: sacrifice a token Companion you control → add 2 Will this turn.
cards.flavor: Tax paid in bodies.

cards.name: King's Cleaver
cards.text: Sacrifice any number of token Companions you control: target Icon takes that much damage. Then Banish this Relic.
cards.flavor: One swing. The whole court.

cards.name: Scrapforge Anvil
cards.text: Whenever you make one or more tokens, you may give one of them +1 Strike until end of turn.
cards.flavor: Hot iron. Hotter blood.

cards.name: Cages of the Tithe
cards.text: Tokens you control have +0/+1/+0. Once per turn: sacrifice a token → target opponent loses 1 Worth.
cards.flavor: Even coin flinches.

cards.name: Red Whip
cards.text: Sacrifice a token Companion you control: ready a Companion you control. Once per turn.
cards.flavor: The lash finds another pair of feet.

cards.name: Crown Hook
cards.text: Your Icon has +1 Strike. Whenever your Icon Presses, you may sacrifice a token: that Press deals +2 damage.
cards.flavor: The hook is not for climbing.

cards.name: Loyalty Brand
cards.text: Attach to a Companion. When you sacrifice a token, the host gets +1 Strike until end of turn.
cards.flavor: A mark that means 'throw me next.'

cards.name: King's Shadow
cards.text: Attach to your Icon. The first token you sacrifice each turn is Banished instead of Removed, then make a Goblin token.
cards.flavor: The shadow keeps a spare.

cards.name: Riot Cord
cards.text: Attach to a Companion. Host has 'Sacrifice this: make two Goblin tokens.'
cards.flavor: Cut the cord. Get the crowd.

cards.name: Blood Ledger
cards.text: Attach to a Companion. Whenever you sacrifice a token, put a mark on this Bond. Remove 3 marks: deal 3 damage to target Icon.
cards.flavor: Every name is a number.

cards.name: Fling the Weak
cards.text: Sacrifice a token Companion you control: deal damage equal to its Health to target Icon.
cards.flavor: They barely weigh anything.

cards.name: All Must Serve
cards.text: Sacrifice any number of token Companions you control. Gain that much Will this turn.
cards.flavor: The king does not ask twice.

cards.name: Sudden Silence
cards.text: Silence target spell on the stack.
cards.flavor: The room goes quiet.

cards.name: Human Shield
cards.text: Sacrifice a token Companion you control: prevent the next 3 damage that would be dealt to your Icon this turn.
cards.flavor: Stand there. That's the whole job.

cards.name: Knife Rain
cards.text: Sacrifice X token Companions you control. Deal X damage divided as you choose among any number of Icons and Companions.
cards.flavor: The sky is cheap metal.

cards.name: Last Order
cards.text: Make two Goblin tokens. They cannot Press this turn.
cards.flavor: Born already running.

cards.name: Eat the Banner
cards.text: Sacrifice a token: destroy target Relic with Store Worth 3 or less.
cards.flavor: Cloth burns faster than pride.

cards.name: The Pits
cards.text: This turn, the first token you make enters with +1 Health.
cards.flavor: Even dry wells remember rain. These remember teeth.

cards.name: Tithe Stone
cards.text: Once this turn, when you sacrifice a token, add 1 Will.
cards.flavor: The stone drinks first.

cards.name: Warrens Mouth
cards.text: Look at the top 2 of your deck. You may reveal a Companion from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom.
cards.flavor: The tunnel always has another body.

cards.name: Ash Altar
cards.text: You may sacrifice a token Companion you control. If you do, deal 1 damage to target Icon.
cards.flavor: Smoke is a kind of prayer.

cards.name: Mustering Gate
cards.text: Make a Goblin token. It cannot Press this turn.
cards.flavor: The gate does not care who walks through.
